contexts.text: They who have been blind in the life of the body, in the other life see equally as well as those who have been lynx-eyed.
The Rational is blind even in natural things...

They struck [the Sodomites] with blindnesses () = that they were filled up with falsities. Blindness is predicated in the Word of those who are in falsity, and also of those who are in ignorance of truth. Both are called blind, but which are meant can be seen from the connexion... Illustrated.
Blind watchmen () = those who from reasoning are in falsity.
The horse of the peoples shall be smitten with blindness () = filled up with falsities.

For judgment am I come into the world, that those who see not may see, but that those who see may become blind. Some of the Pharisees... said, Are we blind too? Jesus said, If ye were blind ye would not have sin; but now ye say, We see, therefore your sin remaineth (). Here the blind are mentioned in both senses... With those who are within the Church and know what is the truth, blindness = falsity; but with those who do not know what is the truth, as those outside the Church, blindness = ignorance of truth. These are blameless.
As blind = what is false... they were forbidden to sacrifice anything blind... And also that a blind priest should offer...
The eyes of the blind shall see () = those who are in ignorance of truth.
The blind, etc. being called... treats of a New Church from the gentiles.
(The blind = a class of the good.)
Those who see () = those who consider themselves more intelligent than everybody else, of whom it is said that they shall become blind, that is, they will not receive faith.
Blind in a good sense = those who are in ignorance of truth, and in the opposite sense, those who are in falsities.
As light corresponds to truth, so darkness corresponds to falsity; and hence they who are in falsities are said to be in blindness.
The blindnesses with which those who were sent by the King of Syria were smitten () = the falsities themselves.
To teach truth without good is to walk blind.
Some of those who are instructed in truths and led to good by the Lord are called the blind.
To open the blind eyes () = (to instruct) those who are in ignorance of good and truth, and who still long to know and imbue them. AE 153:13.
Believes that all things are of blind flow...
The blind () = no faith, from no Knowledges.
Under Miracle, see this reference.
(They who ascend from a lower to a higher Heaven) are struck with blindness...
The blind () = those who are in ignorance of truth, and yet receive it when instructed. AC 9209:4.
The blind leading the blind () = those who are in what is erroneous.
Blind, etc. () = destitute of truths implanted in the life, thus of good.
Their blindness in spiritual things (is from their applying all things of the Word to themselves).
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] The blind = those who are in falsities, and do not want to be instructed. References.
The miracle of the blind receiving sight signified that those received intelligence who had been in ignorance of truth.
Blind faith... AR 914:3. TCR 345:3.
If ye were blind = if ye did not know...

Blind and naked () = that they are without truths and goods. The blind in the Word mean those who are without truths, either from the want of them in the Church, and thus from ignorance, or from not understanding them. Illustrated. AE 239.
We struck them with blindness...
Like a blind man led by a dog... CL 134:4.
Like a blind man in a wood...
Faith in an invisible God is actually blind...
That those who are not in the understanding of truth will then understand, is signified by the opening of the eyes of the blind (). Illustrated.
Blind from his birth () = those who are born outside the Church, and thus could not know anything about the Lord, or be instructed from the Word.
The blind whom the Lord healed signified the spiritually blind, who are they who do not know and understand truths. Illustrated.
Moreover all the blind whom the Lord healed = those who are in ignorance and receive Him, and are enlightened by Him through the Word.
As the blind = those who are not in Knowledges of truth and thence not in any understanding of truth (no blind priest was allowed to offer... and nothing blind was allowed to be offered).
The Lord is called blind and deaf () because He as it were does not see and perceive man's sins...
The blind man () here represented those who cannot see anything of truth because they are sensuous...
The blind () = those who do not see truths. AE 721:10. AE 781:12.

The blindnesses with which (the men of Sodom) were smitten, so that they did not find the door = the plenary rejection and denial of what is Divine and of the holy things of Heaven and the Church, so that they could not see and acknowledge anything of the Church.
